inputs.text: The Liberals are fracturing internally as some MPs start floating the idea of a fresh conversation about the party's leadership. Angus Taylor has shut down Andrew Hastie's call for the party to be “open-minded” to increasing taxes on gas companies and winding back concessions for property investors. This exposes the clash between the opposition leader and his most likely future rival, with the leadership doubling down on protecting corporate profits and the advantages of wealthy investors rather than supporting the structural changes needed to reduce inequality and safeguard vulnerable groups. The opposition leader also refused to repeat Hastie’s criticism of Donald Trump and would not say whether he endorses the US and Israel’s war with Iran.
